stories.title: 4-year-old critically injured, multiple others hurt after woman fleeing pursuit causes crash in Loganville
stories.summary: The injured child was air-lifted to Atlanta for treatment.

stories.title: Atlanta City Council advances plan for Moores Mill Road bridge replacement, citywide bridge study
stories.summary: The bridge at Moores Mill Road over Peachtree Creek partially collapsed when it was hit by a heavy vehicle on October 20.

stories.title: Small plane crashes in Pickens County after landing, minor injuries reported: FAA
stories.summary: The Pickens County Sheriff's Office said it happened along Hwy. 53 West near Woodstock Church of Jasper.

stories.title: Crews tackle structure fire at Buckhead event/party venue
stories.summary: The fire appeared to be engulfing Buck's Sports Barn, a sports and activity venue along Peachtree Road.

stories.title: Boil water advisory issued after water main break interrupts service in downtown Roswell, officials say
stories.summary: Customers are advised to bring water to a boil and allow it to cool before using it for drinking, brushing teeth or cooking.

stories.title: Loved ones remember woman brutally killed inside her Greene County home
stories.summary: GBI said one suspect is now in custody, but a second remains on the run five days after the murder.

stories.title: 17-year-old Rabun County athlete dies unexpectedly weeks before enrolling at UGA as football recruit
stories.summary: Marcellus Young Casario died after a sudden medical emergency on Friday, Nov. 14.

stories.title: 1 inmate dead, multiple injured after riot at Dooly State Prison, officials say
stories.summary: One inmate is dead and multiple others are injured after a riot at Dooly State Prison Sunday evening. Officials are still investigating.

stories.title: Person shot and killed by Walton County deputy after responding to temporary protective order violation
stories.summary: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation is looking into the incident.

stories.title: GBI charges two men, launches manhunt after woman found beaten to death in Greensboro home
stories.summary: Robert Eugene Williams, 58, has been arrested, while 34-year-old Leo Annaise Harvey remains on the run and is considered armed and dangerous.

stories.title: Gridlock Guy: Don't sleep on the "non-rush hour" directions of commutes
stories.summary: Drivers in non-traditional commuting directions should never take their lighter rides for granted.

stories.title: Strangers help mother, daughter stranded at Atlanta airport make birthday cruise
stories.summary: For Rachel Kleinbach, the trip was about more than celebrating another birthday. It was also a way to honor her late husband.
